assumptions.statement: Share of a full year of productivity an AE hired at the start of Q1 2026 delivers in 2026: linear ramp to full productivity over 9 months (average 50%) then 3 months at full productivity = 7.5 of 12 months
assumptions.rationale: Source states full productivity (300 EUR k/yr) is reached after 9 months; the ramp shape is not given, linear is a neutral midpoint (0% during ramp would give 0.25, full from day one 1.0). Upper end also requires all 30 hired on 1 January and enough pipeline.
assumptions.owner: CRO with CFO, validate on the 2025 AE hiring cohort
